Name: JUMP_SPECIFY_ALT_PARAM_ST
Description: Determines the configurations for vertical ascent points in missions.

Fields.Name: Goal Altitude
Fields.Description: Height above the jump start point that the vertical ascent climbs to. In metres.

Fields.Name: Gravity Multiplier
Fields.Description: Gravity multiplier applied during the vertical ascent jump.

Fields.Name: Previous Horizontal Speed Carry-Over
Fields.Description: Multiplier for how much of the previous horizontal speed is kept when the vertical ascent starts.

Fields.Name: Maximum Horizontal Speed
Fields.Description: Maximum horizontal speed during the vertical ascent jump. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Acceleration
Fields.Description: Horizontal acceleration during the vertical ascent jump. In metres per second squared.

Fields.Name: Diagonal Jump: Middle Angle
Fields.Description: Intermediate ascent angle for a diagonal jump, chosen from the stick input when the jump starts. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Diagonal Jump: Maximum Angle
Fields.Description: Maximum ascent angle for a diagonal jump, chosen from the stick input when the jump starts. In degrees.
